identity: Every POST requires workspace_id equal to the currently authorized original warehouse. Existing X-DuckDB-Capability and X-DuckDB-Workspace-ID headers apply.

reads.state: GET /state?before=<edition sequence>&limit=1..100 returns {schema,workspace_id,editions,next_before,views,queries,exports,service,runtime,requests}. Editions use original native paging. Remaining complete native lists are unchanged and explicit. The requests field is {requests:[complete original records],next_before}; views is an array. installed_runtime is the exact original runtime_info result.
reads.lineage: GET /lineage?edition_id=...&export_id=...&publication_id=...; any selected IDs optional but at least one required. Returns original selected edition, original export/publication, complete snapshot_editions and each full retained source/member descriptor, exact query+views, availability and receipt-only payment status. Does not assert that every saved view is a SQL dependency.
reads.source: GET /source?edition_id=...&name=...&offset=0&limit=65536 returns exact retained original member base64 byte page, bytes/sha256, offset/end/next_offset; validates complete original member SHA before each page. Full source download/export uses native source-handoff.
reads.request: GET /requests/<32hex> returns original immutable request + current COMPLETE/PENDING outcome; GET /history?before=<sequence>&limit=1..100 pages all original workflow requests.

posts.inspect: POST /inspect {workspace_id,report_path}: original inspect_delivery; incomplete reports return original error and are never imported.
posts.preview: POST /preview {workspace_id,sql,parameters?,max_rows?,expected_views}: original read-only SQL preview, explicit truncation; max_rows<=1000; exact selected views required.
posts.command: POST /command {workspace_id,request_id:<32hex>,action,args}; persist exact original input before work; same request+body recovers, different body rejects. Returns {schema,workspace_id,request_id,action,state:'COMPLETE',request,request_sha256,result,reconciliation}. Actual native errors remain PENDING with last_error and exact retained intent. Authoritatively read-only basis rejection or native save-query StateError with successful rollback before commit returns state REJECTED, result:{error:{code},no_effect:true}; same request replays that terminal receipt. Other errors remain PENDING.

import.review_id: native ID of an exact completed workflow review; the full reviewed source triple is retained as import basis

nativeExisting.reviewPublication: POST /api/vgi/review {export_id,batch_rows?}; returns original review for explicit publish.
nativeExisting.service: Original /api/vgi/configure,/start,/stop,/activate remain untouched in existing VGI operator.
nativeExisting.downloads: GET /api/exports/<export_id>/file?name=<original manifest name> with original capability. Export/source-handoff command returns original export record/files.
nativeExisting.sqlHandover: 32C2 owns selected-result SQL handover route+consumer; workflow links to that exact selected publication. No second SQL engine.
nativeExisting.exactSourcePrecondition: Original DatasetWorkspace.review_import/import_review accept optional expected_source with all three hashes; old callers preserve existing behavior. Current dataset postimage is part of this source selection.

browser: Root owns complete separate workflow HTML/JS/CSS. Persist full per-tab draft+exact pending command before POST; recover using /requests then same /command; never silently create another request after transport failure. Show full native source and separate explicit dataset import/query/export/publication controls. Original history/source remains in warehouse and portable native backup. No payment action occurs in this generic workflow. Only explicit REJECTED with result.no_effect===true permits clearing the pending intent while retaining full history and editable inputs. For uncertain PENDING, an explicit alternative must keep the original copy/request unresolved and reject a new request with identical action+args.
